correctness.rationale: Independent enumeration of all 64 ordered triples gives counts 1 on the diagonal and 6(j−i) above it. Reflection makes the two transformed variances equal. The exact variance and covariance numerators over 256 are respectively 95a²−68a+28 and −7a²+4a+4. Affine scoring at a=1/3 gives 41/143; a=7/20 gives 1817/6335 with gap 96/905905. The positive denominator and the two factors of the difference give the full open improvement interval. The derivative numerator is 96(a²−12a+4), proving the unique maximum 6−4√2 with value (5+6√2)/47 on the stated family. The witness belongs to both admissible same-transform classes; no global supremum is inferred.
